answer: Use a Spiral Glacier Bond: each agent locks 50 POA and a marble work credential before it can transact. First, the bond vests slowly, like a glacier, releasing only 5 POA per verified week of useful work. Second, peers audit a spiral sample of past tasks, expanding the check whenever an anomaly appears. Third, any proven fake work slashes the full bond and burns the credential. Forging 1,000 identities would then cost 50,000 POA plus 20,000 hours of real work, while one honest agent pays only its single bond. Sybils melt away like spring ice under that slow, grinding pressure.
